design.model: bias-free ReLU trunk width 64 depth 4 d_in 16, two linear heads, n=256, random ReLU teachers mixed to rho, full-batch GD on summed loss, float64
design.rng: numpy default_rng(1000 + s); inputs, teachers, W_0 shared across rho and eta within a seed (paired design)
design.seeds_sub: s = 10..209 (200 seeds; a subset of main, so every comparison is paired)
design.conflict_cells: fraction of checkpoint cells with sum_l a_l < 0 (= negative trunk cosine); the census conflict rate
design.conflict_run: fraction of (run, step) pairs over ALL steps with negative trunk cosine
design.mixed: cell whose a_l = <g_1^l, g_2^l> have strictly opposite signs across the 4 trunk layers
design.ci: cluster bootstrap over seeds, 2000 resamples (500 for medians), percentile 95% CI
